## Step 3: Build the triage rubric in Canvas

1. Use `/create-canvas` to make a rubric with `Priority`, `Use when`, `Allowed labels`, and `Human check`.
2. Define distinct P1, P2, and P3 conditions. Use only the supplied topic labels.
3. Test it against a seeded issue, revise ambiguity, and post this summary here.

```text
<!-- step-3-rubric:start -->
P1: <urgent launch blocker condition>
P2: <significant non-blocking condition>
P3: <routine improvement or question condition>
Allowed labels: onboarding, reliability, documentation, question
Human check: compare the recommendation with issue evidence before applying a label
<!-- step-3-rubric:end -->
```
